title: Concept: Server-Timing exposes backend timing to every client
description: Server-Timing names internal phases and their durations, so anonymous callers learn the timing profile of each backend hop. Those measurements expose cache state and load without any error message being returned.
applicability: Responses from application servers and edges that expose performance metrics.
risk: An attacker measures response phases to confirm blind injection, infer cache partitioning or schedule load against the slowest hop, none of which requires an error or a stack trace.
